_draft_note_zh: 成熟度证据补采 brief 草案（2026-11-13），未提交采集。口径面向「已成形可用→摄取 / 不成熟→待 PoC」分池，不补能力声明。每个 criterion 的中文目的见同目录 2026-11-13-brief.criteria.md。keywords 一律为判别性长短语（正文匹配词），采集前须通过 2026-11-13-precheck.py 的 keyword×tree 碰撞预检。

brief.topic: Maturity evidence (not capability claims) for splitting OPN-like projects into 'formed & actually usable -> ingest' vs 'immature / in-design -> PoC backlog': is there an installable/runnable implementation, a reviewable behavior contract or test gate, release & version-skew handling, upstream governance & license (modifiable vs fork-only), and contract fixtures? Problem-discovery stage; no adoption ranking, no solution design, no capability scoring.

criteria.question: Is there an installable / runnable implementation rather than a README-only declaration (install command, build-from-source, runtime requirement, published binary or package)?
keywords: install it globally with npm install -g
to build from source, run
requires Node.js 20 or Python 3.11 or newer
prebuilt binaries are published for macOS and Linux
start the server with docker compose up
a single compiled binary with no runtime dependencies
published to the npm registry / PyPI

criteria.question: Is there a reviewable behavior contract or test gate (CI, test command, assertions, merge gate, contract or snapshot tests)?
keywords: run the full test suite with
all tests must pass before a pull request can be merged
continuous integration runs on every push
contract tests assert the request and response shape
coverage must not fall below
the state machine transitions are verified by
snapshot / golden-file comparison is committed

criteria.question: Are there tagged releases, a changelog, semantic versioning, migration / breaking-change notes and explicit version-skew handling between components?
keywords: released under semantic versioning
see the changelog for breaking changes
this version requires a migration from
the server and client must be on the same minor version
pinned to a specific commit in the manifest
a deprecation policy for the public API
tagged releases are published on a fixed cadence

criteria.question: What is the license and upstream governance: can it be modified and contributed to, or is fork-only / docs-only / archived the only option?
keywords: licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
released under the MIT License
we do not accept code contributions, only documentation
all contributors must sign a Contributor License Agreement
pull requests are reviewed and merged by the maintainers
fork the repository to customize it for your own deployment
the project is archived and no longer maintained

criteria.question: Do contract fixtures exist (golden / snapshot / testdata / black-box contract examples) that pin expected behavior?
keywords: golden files are stored alongside the tests
black-box contract fixtures define the expected behavior
the testdata directory contains reproducible inputs and outputs
snapshot tests are committed to the repository
a minimal reproducible example is provided
the fixture pins the wire format
